meta.generated_for: Razorpay AI PM Build Challenge prototype

assumptions.Merchant: Lumio Analytics Pvt Ltd (fictional) - Bengaluru B2B SaaS, bills US clients in USD via Razorpay
assumptions.EEFC holding switched on: 2026-09-01 (before this, every USD receipt was converted to INR at settlement)
assumptions.Inbound conversion: Razorpay live mid-market rate, 0% FX markup (per Razorpay's published MoneySaver pricing); platform fee ignored as it is identical in both scenarios
assumptions.Outward FX via corporate card (AWS, tool: 3.0% all-in markup over mid (assumption; Indian business cards typically 2-3.5%)
assumptions.Outward FX via bank wire (contractor): 0.9% markup over mid + Rs 1,200 flat charge per wire (assumption)
assumptions.EEFC rule: Accruals in a calendar month must be converted to INR by the last day of the following month, after USD used for permitted payments (RBI Master Direction - Deposits and Accounts)
assumptions.USD/INR: Synthetic daily mid-rate path (business days), ~84.1 to ~88.4; NOT real market data
assumptions.INR safety buffer policy: Rs 8,00,000 minimum in INR current account (merchant setting)
assumptions.Confidence score: Illustrative heuristic = history depth x timing regularity x amount stability (see Demo_Scenario notes)

recommendations.title: Convert the remaining September balance
recommendations.action: Convert USD 21,332 from the Sep-2026 bucket on Fri 30 Oct 2026
recommendations.reasoning: RBI EEFC rule: September accruals must be converted by the last day of October. 31 Oct is a Saturday, so the agent schedules Friday. Cannot be skipped; amount is the unutilised balance.
recommendations.merchant_can: View / change execution time only (must be on or before 30 Oct)

recommendations.title: Fund the 2 Nov payroll and 5 Nov rent
recommendations.action: Convert USD 23,800 from the Oct-2026 bucket on Thu 29 Oct 2026
recommendations.reasoning: Payroll ~INR 37.1L (24 of 24 months on the 1st/next business day) + rent INR 3.36L + INR 8L buffer, minus current INR balance INR 8.56L and the locked Sep conversion (~INR 18.9L).
recommendations.merchant_can: Approve / edit amount or date / skip

recommendations.title: Hold USD for AWS and tools - do not convert
recommendations.action: Keep USD 9,700 in EEFC to pay AWS (3 Nov) and tools (9 Nov) directly in USD
recommendations.reasoning: Paying from USD avoids buying dollars back at ~3% card markup (~INR 25.7k saved). AWS estimate USD 7,278 (range 6,186-8,369); held amount covers the top of the range.
recommendations.merchant_can: Confirm expected AWS bill, then approve / edit / skip
recommendations.flagged_input: AWS bill amount - Oct was 31% above the prior 5-month average

recommendations.title: Will the team offsite recur this November?
recommendations.reasoning: An INR 4.2L payment to Coorg Retreats appeared once (14 Nov 2025). One occurrence is not enough to forecast it, so the agent asks instead of guessing.
recommendations.merchant_can: Yes (adds INR 4.2L to the Nov plan) / No / Not sure (agent keeps extra buffer)
recommendations.flagged_input: Is this a recurring annual expense?

recommendations.title: Convert the rest of the October balance in 2 tranches
recommendations.action: Convert USD 18,800 on Mon 16 Nov and USD 18,890 on Thu 26 Nov
recommendations.reasoning: October accruals must be converted by 30 Nov. Splitting into two dates avoids converting the whole balance at a single day's rate; the INR funds GST (20 Nov) and the 1 Dec payroll.
recommendations.merchant_can: Change tranche dates/split (all must complete by 30 Nov)

recommendations.title: Top up for the 1 Dec payroll from November receipts
recommendations.action: Convert ~USD 6,300 from November receipts around 27 Nov
recommendations.reasoning: Depends on ~USD 45,450 from on-time clients (reliable), plus Atlas Freight USD 17,110 (new client, only 3 payments seen) and Brightpath's overdue Oct invoice USD 8,630 (habitually 30-45 days late).
recommendations.merchant_can: Confirm whether Atlas/Brightpath payments are expected, then approve / edit / skip
recommendations.flagged_input: Timing of Atlas Freight (new) and Brightpath Health (late payer) receipts

value_at_stake.note: Cost of converting all USD to INR at settlement, then buying USD back (card 3% / wire 0.9% + fee) to pay AWS, tools and the contractor. Netting from EEFC removes this. Excludes any rate-timing effect, which is not claimed.
